messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx and p99 token latency on /v1/complete for model redwood-serve-q4 in ap-southeast-1. Threshold: 5xx > 8% for 5m. Paging @nina_oncall.

nina_oncall: Acknowledged. Pulling up graphs and recent deploys.

rob_sre: Deploy log shows deploy-bot rolled redwood-serve-q4:v3q at 03:05:12 UTC. Spike starts ~03:07. Seeing `kv_cache_miss` spikes and dozens of `batch_alloc_fail` traces.

emma_runtime: Heap snapshots from workers show paired increases in batch-size allocation and eviction churn. Runtime warning: `cache_key_entropy_low` logged repeatedly. Also note quantization config change: per-token fingerprint width reduced from 16->8 bits in v3q.

nina_oncall: Tenant impact? Which customers hit?

rob_sre: Two Dedicated tenants on the ap-southeast pool and multiple hosted sessions with short-living chats hitting 502/timeouts. Retry storm observed.

jules_product: Marking customer-impacting. Notifying account team for both tenants.

emma_runtime: Quick hypothesis: reduced fingerprint width + minor substitution in tokenizer changed rare-token encoding -> more collisions in KV keyspace -> thrash (lots of misses) -> cold model loads and larger batch allocations -> tail latency and occasional worker restarts. Heavy batching amplified it.

nina_oncall: Live mitigations?

emma_runtime: Options: 1) drain q4 variant -> fallback to qfloat, 2) limit pool max_batch_size to 48, 3) flush KV cache for q4, 4) rollback deploy if necessary, 5) enable canary gate for quant variants. Suggest 1+2+3 now.

rob_sre: Agreed. I'll coordinate routing and pool updates with ops.

nina_oncall: Running routing change: `rdw route set --model redwood-serve-q4 --state=draining --fallback=redwood-serve-f32 --region=ap-southeast-1`

ops-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: redwood-serve-q4 set to draining; fallback redwood-serve-f32 (initiated by nina_oncall).

rob_sre: Flushing KV for model: `kvcachectl flush --model redwood-serve-q4 --region ap-southeast-1 --force`  flush in progress (~25s).

ops-bot: POOL_UPDATE: `poolctl set --pool ap-se-1-main --max-batch 48` (initiated by rob_sre).

deploy-bot: DEPLOY_LOG: v3q marked as candidate; manual rollback available.

nina_oncall: Enabling verbose per-request KV traces for 12m: `telemetryctl debug --filter "model:redwood-serve-q4" --retention 12m`

rob_sre: After mitigations, 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 2.1% within 7 minutes. p99 token latency decreased but p99 for long sessions still slightly elevated.

emma_runtime: We captured sample traces showing repeated `kv_lookup_miss` followed by cold load which correlates with batches that include rare tokens. Also found a small number of cache-key collisions: hashed fingerprint collisions measured at ~0.3% post-deploy, baseline 0.01%.

jules_product: Customer window: 03:05-03:16 UTC. Preparing communications.

kiran_pm: Scheduling internal postmortem. Proposed slot: 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC. Invite runtime, SRE, eng-ops, product, customer success.

nina_oncall: Works for me.

rob_sre: Action items and owners (creating tickets):
- emma_runtime -> INFR-5120: Regression test in CI to fuzz quantized logits & token encodings; measure cache-key collision rate and KV miss effect under synthetic load.
- rob_sre -> MON-2311: Dashboard + alert: per-model kv_collision_rate, kv_eviction_rate, batch_alloc_fail count; alert if collision_rate > 0.1% or eviction_rate > 4%/min.
- nina_oncall -> SRE-4217: Update runbook with exact commands for drain, kvcache flush, pool batch limit, and rollback procedure.
- ops-bot -> OPS-3522: Autoscaler policy change: soft cap default max_batch 64 with per-model override; implement canary routing policy (1% traffic, 30m) for new quant variants.
- jules_product -> CS-1310: Draft customer-facing incident summary and timeline for affected tenants.

emma_runtime: Long-term fixes: pin quantization fingerprint width until CI fuzzing passes; add deterministic fallback to cache-key computation when entropy metric dips; add a per-model safe-max-batch heuristic based on historical memory profiles.

kiran_pm: Prioritization: INFR-5120 and SRE-4217 = P0. MON-2311 and OPS-3522 = P1. CS-1310 = P0.

rob_sre: Verification plan examples to include in tickets:
- INFR-5120: CI fuzz harness runs 20k sessions, collision_rate < 0.05%, tail-latency regression < 10% vs baseline.
- OPS-3522: staging canary with 1% traffic for 30m; block rollout if kv_collision_rate > 0.1% or p95 latency degrades > 20%.
- MON-2311: create dashboard panels with deploy overlays and per-model histograms.

emma_runtime: I'll draft a design doc for deterministic fallback and prototype in a feature-flag gated branch. Will include perf benchmarks.

nina_oncall: Creating SRE-4217 now and attaching logs + mitigation commands.

ops-bot: TICKET CREATED: SRE-4217 -> https://tracker.internal/SRE-4217 (runbook update).

kiran_pm: Calendar invite for postmortem: 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z sent. Please add preliminary notes to ticket pages and tag @kiran_pm on updates.

jules_product: I'll coordinate with account teams before customer notes go out.

nina_oncall: Leaving model on drain until postmortem and INFR-5120 verification in staging. Will re-enable when we get green light.

emma_runtime: Small follow-up: consider preserving a tiny deterministic salt in cache-key derivation for quantized builds to avoid entropy collapse but make reversing possible for identical model determinism; filing design in INFR-5120.

rob_sre: Good catch. Add to INFR-5120 scope.

jules_product: Closing live alert channel. Thread remains open for postmortem artifacts.

nina_oncall: Thanks all for the quick response. Attaching logs to SRE-4217 and will update last_message_ts when postmortem doc is posted.

(END)
